items.headline: Baleba plays first minutes in behind-closed-doors friendly vs Lausanne
items.summary: Summer signing Carlos Baleba made his first appearance for Manchester United in a behind-closed-doors match on Friday after recovering from an ankle injury sustained before his arrival.

items.headline: JJ Gabriel featured in first-team squad photo amid transfer interest
items.summary: Manchester United included academy prospect JJ Gabriel in the official squad photo, signalling his involvement in Carrick's plans, though Real Madrid and Barcelona remain interested in the youngster.

items.headline: Man Utd in talks to pursue Freiburg striker Igor Matanovic
items.summary: Manchester United reportedly in internal discussions over potential move for Croatian striker Igor Matanovic, with competition from Arsenal and five other Premier League clubs monitoring the situation.
